findings.label: Implicit root favicon still needs Nginx (informational, documented)
findings.detail: The browser's implicit GET /favicon.ico at the domain root cannot be redirected from inside the app. _Layout.cshtml documents the one-line Nginx fallback (location = /favicon.ico { return 301 /crmweb/favicon.ico; }). No app-side action; forward to whoever owns the Nginx config so the tab spinner fully resolves in production.
